label: Embedded
description: Objects usually embedded into Logistic Objects

label: Core
description: Objects essential for the transportation supply chain

label: Common
description: Common objects that are usually used linked to other Logistic Objects

label: Abstract
description: Superclass not used as such, e.g. LogisticsObject

label: Action
description: Objects belonging to LogisticsAction superclass, e.g. Loading

label: Billing & Settlement
description: Objects specifically used for Billing & Settlement purposes

label: Distribution
description: Objects designed and used mostly for Distribution

label: Dangerous Goods
description: Objects specifically used for transportation of Dangerous Goods as per the DGR

label: Live Animals
description: Objects specifically used for transportation of Live Animals as per the LAR
